name: Io Makandal
read: A floating assemblage of foliage, textiles and paintings that refuses to hold still — the organic matter inside ‘Frondescent’ keeps decaying, so the work is never the same twice. Entropy isn’t fought here; it’s the medium. Most artists race time. This one collaborates with it.

name: Zizipho Poswa
read: Bronze-cast crowns resting on monumental hand-coiled earthenware — two materials, two tempos, one gesture of honour. ‘ooMolokazana boZikhali’ carries ceremony and weight in the same breath. On now in ‘iMbewu (The Seed)’ at Southern Guild NY until 21 Aug.
